answer: Nothing else I trust stops a clone farm as cleanly as Page trimmer gilt edge warrant stitched into the gilding shop register, proven by each gilt edge is a year of bindery logs in the stitching ledger, so a farm must. Minutes add up the same way: 16 for one, 10064 for 629, and the farm pays in afternoons it never gets back. Put the harbor on the table, put the vine next to it, and put the lagoon underneath: the pile is the proof. The farm's sums stop working the moment each alias is charged separately.
